title: Labor Law, Article 25-A (New York State Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act)
verified_how: Fetched the URL. The heading reads 'New York State Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act', §§860-860-I, ten sections.
notes: Covers mass-layoff and plant-closing notice and back-pay liability. NY has no general statutory severance. At-will employment is common law. The written termination notice (Labor Law §195(6)) is in Article 6.
